data.text: Friction: competitive-snapshot.md on disk and DOC-41 are the same text with links rewritten (feature-gap.md -> DOC-47 and so on). Updating it meant diffing both by hand, re-applying the link rewrite with sed, and then doc edit --file. Nothing reports when the two drift. Also: the 16 KiB size warning appeared only after the revision was saved, so it could not shape the edit.
